The code of this repository implements a novel approach to improve an embedding-Large Language 
Model (embedding-LLM) of interest by infusing the knowledge formalized by a reference ontology:
metadata.reason: Explicitly states the repository's main purpose.

metadata.value: boosting the ability of the considered embedding-LLM to effectively model the knowledge domain described by the infused ontology

the knowledge domain described by the infused ontology.
